chunks: And with his statement, peace be upon him:
"Islam prevails and is not prevailed over."

key_terms.لَا يُعْلَى عَلَيْهِ: it is not superseded, dominated, or placed beneath another

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith "Islam prevails and is not prevailed over" mean?
ai.summary: This hadith states a principle of the superiority and ascendancy of Islam. In the legal context of inheritance among followers of different religions, it is cited as a foundational maxim affirming that Islam is not subordinated to other religious systems.
